scene afterthegardener1
: Well, that wasn’t a very good story at all.
lines.zh: : 嗯,那个故事一点也不好。

lines.en: : Yeah, I think we’re all in agreement that Futaba wins this one. And yes, it’s technically supposed to be up to {i}Sensei{/i} who decides, but...nah.
lines.zh: : 是啊,我想我们都同意这一局 Futaba 赢了。没错,理论上该由 {i}Sensei{/i} 来决定,不过……算了。

lines.en: : Agreed. Where’s he taking Nodoka, though? I don’t really like the two of them wandering off together when she’s...Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 同意。不过他把 Nodoka 带到哪儿去了?我真的不太喜欢他们两个单独走开,毕竟她是……Nodoka 啊。

lines.en: : I’m not...quite sure...
lines.zh: : 我……不太确定……

lines.en: : And I’m not...quite sure what that story was about either...
lines.zh: : 我也……不太确定那个故事讲的是什么……

lines.en: : I’ve heard her go on rants like that in the past, but...there was...something different about that one. It sounded almost like-
lines.zh: : 我以前也听她这样长篇大论过,不过……那一次……有点不一样。听起来几乎像是——

lines.en: : It sounded beautiful.
lines.zh: : 听起来很美。

lines.en: scene afterthegardener2
: Um...Yasu? Is it possible you’re just misunderstanding the maniacal ramblings of a strange girl? Because, as someone who does that rather frequently yourself, I see that as a real possibility.
lines.zh: : 呃……Yasu?有没有可能你只是误解了一个古怪女孩的疯言疯语?因为你自己就经常干这种事,所以我觉得这个可能性相当大。

lines.en: : An infinite stream of light...being trapped in stasis...and spending forever with someone who can never leave you...does that not sound wonderful to the rest of you?
lines.zh: : 一道无限的光流……被困在停滞之中……和一个永远无法离开你的人共度永远……你们其他人难道不觉得这很美妙吗?

lines.en: : You’re thinking too much into it, Yasu. I doubt any of that actually meant anything.
lines.zh: : 你想太多了,Yasu。我很怀疑那些到底有没有什么含义。

lines.en: : Or maybe our brains are just too small or something? Nodoka {i}is{/i} a computer after all.
lines.zh: : 或者只是我们的脑子太小了之类的?Nodoka 毕竟{i}是{/i}一台电脑。

lines.en: : There are parts I don’t understand, though...
lines.zh: : 不过有些地方我不明白……

lines.en: : Why did the light kill what it touched?
lines.zh: : 为什么那道光会杀死它触碰到的东西?

lines.en: : How were we able to break free from the ice and think all of those things and feel all of those feelings?
lines.zh: : 我们是怎么从冰里挣脱出来,去想那些念头、感受那些感情的?

lines.en: scene black
$ beachwarfloor1points += 1
: And why were there three moons when I can only see two?
lines.zh: : 还有,我明明只看到两个月亮,为什么故事里有三个?

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
Near the beginning of Nodoka’s story, my niece and her loving friends went to go for a walk.
lines.zh: 在 Nodoka 的故事讲到开头没多久的时候,我的侄女和她那些可爱的朋友们去散步了。

lines.en: I was supposed to go with them.
lines.zh: 我本来应该跟她们一起去的。

lines.en: But thirteen steps in, my head began to pound and my shoes filled up with sand.
lines.zh: 可刚走出十三步,我的头就开始抽痛,鞋子里也灌满了沙子。

lines.en: I was violated by a barrage of thoughts that made me feel as if following them would lead to something painful for everyone.
lines.zh: 我被一连串的念头侵犯,它们让我觉得,跟着她们走下去会给所有人带来痛苦。

lines.en: I am not good with pain.
lines.zh: 我不擅长面对痛苦。

lines.en: When I was younger and less careful, my wounds would be dressed by a woman in lace.
lines.zh: 在我更年轻、更不小心的时候,我的伤口会由一个穿蕾丝的女人来包扎。

lines.en: They came frequently then.
lines.zh: 那时候,伤口来得很频繁。

lines.en: I can not remember how or why, but I remember their existence. And I remember how I’d sully her beautiful hands with my bodily fluids.
lines.zh: 我不记得是怎么弄的、也不记得为什么,但我记得它们的存在。我还记得我是怎样用自己的体液弄脏她那双美丽的手的。

lines.en: She’s in a place now.
lines.zh: 她现在在某一个地方。

lines.en: It is not better or worse.
lines.zh: 那里不算更好,也不算更糟。

lines.en: It is not dark or light.
lines.zh: 那里不黑暗,也不明亮。

lines.en: All I know is it is far from here.
lines.zh: 我唯一知道的,是它离这儿很远。

lines.en: But sometimes, it feels like it’s not.
lines.zh: 可有的时候,又感觉它并不远。

lines.en: And it’s in those moments that I remember how much I used to hurt.
lines.zh: 而在那些瞬间,我就会想起自己曾经有多么痛苦。

lines.en: It’s fine, though.
lines.zh: 不过没关系。

lines.en: scene black
if harukapredator == False:
Because I no longer need the woman in lace.
lines.zh: 因为我不再需要那个穿蕾丝的女人了。

lines.en: I’ve learned other ways to make the pain go away.
lines.zh: 我学会了别的让痛苦消失的方法。

lines.en: : Nodoka.
lines.zh: : Nodoka。

lines.en: : You don’t have to speak.
lines.zh: : 你不必开口。

lines.en: : I already know what you want.
lines.zh: : 我已经知道你想要什么了。

lines.en: {i}You lie with a child.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你和一个孩子躺在一起。{/i}

lines.en: $ nodoka_lust += 1
{i}Her lust goes up by one.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}她的欲望上升了 1 点。{/i}

lines.en: {i}And you justify it by avoiding eye contact.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}而你用回避目光接触来为自己开脱。{/i}

lines.en: {i}To you, it does not matter who it is.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}对你来说,对方是谁并不重要。{/i}

lines.en: {i}It makes no difference what she believes or how long she has been here.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}她相信什么、她在这里多久了,都没有区别。{/i}

lines.en: {i}You just want to make the pain go away.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你只是想让痛苦消失。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But I will never let you do that.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}但我永远不会让你得逞。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Because I know the real you wants to look into her eyes.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}因为我知道,真正的你想要注视她的眼睛。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Soon, you’ll be forced to do just that.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}很快,你就会被逼着那么做。{/i}

lines.en: {i}And I hope that, in that moment, you’ll come to understand your place.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}而我希望,在那一刻,你会明白自己的位置。{/i}

lines.en: {i}You have always been the bidder’s organs.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你一直都只是出价人的器官。{/i}

lines.en: {i}You only think you are important.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你只是以为自己很重要。{/i}

scene afterthegardener3
Because I know I don’t have to hurt alone.
lines.zh: 因为我知道,我不必一个人承受痛苦。

lines.en: There are others who can hurt with me.
lines.zh: 还有别人可以陪我一起痛。

lines.en: And I can add more to the mix whenever I want.
lines.zh: 而且只要我愿意,随时可以往里面加更多人。

lines.en: I can create a world where everyone hurts — a world where I won’t be the outcast.
lines.zh: 我可以创造一个所有人都痛苦的世界——一个我不会是异类的世界。

lines.en: Feelings are just feelings when you chip away at their exoskeleton. Each one of them is temporary. And they can all be replaced or swapped out for others whenever you will it.
lines.zh: 只要你凿开感情的外骨骼,感情就只是感情而已。每一种都是暂时的。只要你愿意,它们随时都能被替换成别的感情。

lines.en: The problem is bringing yourself to will it.
lines.zh: 问题在于,要让自己真的愿意。

lines.en: But that will not be a problem for me tonight.
lines.zh: 不过今晚,这对我来说不是问题。

lines.en: Tonight, there is nothing I {i}need{/i} to change as this creature exists for me to hurt.
lines.zh: 今晚我{i}不需要{/i}改变什么,因为这个生物存在的意义就是供我伤害。

lines.en: She has volunteered to take on all of my pain and will not turn away from the real me as she understands just how lost that person is.
lines.zh: 她自愿承担我所有的痛苦,也不会因为看到真实的我而转身离开,因为她明白那个人有多么迷失。

lines.en: There are others like her. Not {i}exactly{/i} like her, but like her nonetheless.
lines.zh: 还有其他人像她。{i}不完全{/i}像她,但依然是像她。

lines.en: They think the same way about me and acknowledge what I am.
lines.zh: 她们对我的看法也一样,并且承认我是什么。

lines.en: But I want to {i}protect{/i} those people.
lines.zh: 但我想{i}保护{/i}那些人。

lines.en: Not this one.
lines.zh: 不是这一个。

lines.en: This one can protect {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: 这一个,可以保护{i}我{/i}。

lines.en: : Did you like my story, Akira?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢我的故事吗,Akira?

lines.en: : What was it?
lines.zh: : 那是个什么故事?

lines.en: : Were you not paying attention?
lines.zh: : 你没有在听吗?

lines.en: : I was paying attention. I just want to know what it was.
lines.zh: : 我在听。我只是想知道那到底是什么。

lines.en: : Aren’t you supposed to be a poet? I assumed creative analysis was well within your wheelhouse.
lines.zh: : 你不是个诗人吗?我以为创意分析完全在你的能力范围之内。

lines.en: : Just tell me what I was supposed to take away from that.
lines.zh: : 直接告诉我,我应该从那里面领悟到什么。

lines.en: : How about we start with {i}you{/i} telling {i}me{/i} what you’ve {i}already{/i} taken away from it? Because I doubt you’d have whisked me away if it meant absolutely {i}nothing{/i} to you.
lines.zh: : 不如先由{i}你{/i}来告诉{i}我{/i},你{i}已经{/i}领悟到了什么?因为如果它对你{i}毫无{/i}意义,我怀疑你根本不会把我带走。

lines.en: : It made me feel alone. Like I’ve been overlooking something that’s been right beside me this whole time.
lines.zh: : 它让我感到孤独。就好像我一直忽略了某个一直就在我身边的东西。

lines.en: : {i}This whole time{/i} meaning...what, exactly?
lines.zh: : {i}「一直」{/i}是指……具体多久?

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: : Is that what you wanted? To make me feel alone?
lines.zh: : 那就是你想要的吗?让我感到孤独?

lines.en: : Do you believe I’m the type to revel in the suffering of others?
lines.zh: : 你以为我是那种以他人的痛苦为乐的人吗?

lines.en: : If that suffering entertains you, yeah. I do.
lines.zh: : 如果那种痛苦能让你开心,那我是这么想的。

lines.en: : Then, allow me to rephrase — do you believe I’m the type to revel in the suffering of {i}you?{/i}
lines.zh: : 那请允许我换个说法——你以为我是那种以{i}「你的」{/i}痛苦为乐的人吗?

lines.en: : I admire you, Akira. And a great deal at that.
lines.zh: : 我很欣赏你,Akira。而且是相当欣赏。

lines.en: : Why, I’d even let you impregnate me if you so desired. That is how committed I am to remaining by your side.
lines.zh: : 只要你想要,我甚至愿意让你使我怀孕。这就是我有多么坚定地想留在你身边。

lines.en: : But why?
lines.zh: : 可为什么?

lines.en: : Why are you so interested in me? And Ami now too? You’ve been following her around since the poetry contest.
lines.zh: : 你为什么对我这么感兴趣?现在还有 Ami?从诗歌比赛之后你就一直跟着她。

lines.en: : Have I? I suppose I didn’t notice.
lines.zh: : 有吗?我想我没注意到。

lines.en: : Do you know something, Nodoka?
lines.zh: : 你是不是知道些什么,Nodoka?

lines.en: : I know {i}many{/i} things, Akira. But none of them particularly {i}matter{/i} to me. And I’d be happy to tell you why I’ve been following your adorable niece around, but...
lines.zh: : 我知道{i}很多{/i}事,Akira。但没有一件对我特别{i}重要{/i}。我也很乐意告诉你我为什么一直跟着你可爱的侄女,不过……

lines.en: scene afterthegardener4
: I’m afraid you might not like what you hear...
lines.zh: : 我怕你听了会不高兴……

lines.en: : Perhaps another day, when I think you’re capable of taking a bigger hit, I’ll share it with you.
lines.zh: : 也许改天,等我觉得你承受得住更大的打击时,我会告诉你的。

lines.en: : But for now, I think the best way for you to remain authentic is to continue growing at your {i}own{/i} pace. Not the one you’d have me force upon you.
lines.zh: : 至于现在,我觉得让你保持真实的最好方式,就是让你继续按{i}自己的{/i}节奏成长。而不是按我希望强加给你的节奏。

lines.en: : Do you love me?
lines.zh: : 你爱我吗?

lines.en: : I believe I do. Do you me?
lines.zh: : 我想是的。你爱我吗?

lines.en: : Not really, no.
lines.zh: : 不太爱,不爱。

lines.en: scene afterthegardener5
: Ah! My poor heart! And to think I gave you my virginity...
lines.zh: : 啊!我可怜的心!想想看,我可是把处女之身给了你……

lines.en: : Have you told anyone about that?
lines.zh: : 你把这件事告诉过别人吗?

lines.en: scene afterthegardener6
: Just my diary.
lines.zh: : 只有我的日记。

lines.en: : And has that diary been published yet?
lines.zh: : 那本日记出版了吗?

lines.en: : It’s undergoing a few revisions as we speak. Expect it on shelves next Thursday. I had {i}plenty{/i} of great things to say about you, you know.
lines.zh: : 眼下正在进行几处修订。预计下周四上架。我可是写了你{i}很多{/i}好话呢,你知道吗。

lines.en: : I bet you did.
lines.zh: : 我想也是。

lines.en: : Why did you take me all the way out here, Akira?
lines.zh: : 你为什么把我带到这么远的地方来,Akira?

lines.en: : Would you like to fuck me again?
lines.zh: : 想再操我一次吗?

lines.en: : It was your story. It made me want you.
lines.zh: : 是你的故事。它让我想要你。

lines.en: : Mm...yes. I’m sure that’s it. There’s simply {i}no way{/i} you’d just be confused and running from some {i}other{/i} feeling instead, correct?
lines.zh: : 嗯……是啊。我相信就是这样。你{i}绝对不可能{/i}是因为困惑、在逃避{i}别的{/i}什么感受,对吧?

lines.en: : Does it matter?
lines.zh: : 有区别吗?

lines.en: : I suppose not. Now that we’ve already fallen for one another, I have no qualms with letting you bed me anywhere you like. I’m just not sure which words I should be whispering into your ear this time.
lines.zh: : 我想没有。既然我们已经双双坠入情网,你爱在哪儿睡我都毫无怨言。我只是不确定这次该往你耳边说些什么。

lines.en: : How about we just don’t talk at all?
lines.zh: : 我们要不干脆一句话都别说?

lines.en: : That doesn’t sound entirely horrible. But you might need to cover my mouth. I quite enjoyed crying out in pleasure during our last night together and would likely do it again without some {i}assistance.{/i}
lines.zh: : 听起来倒也不算太糟。不过你可能需要捂住我的嘴。我们共度的那一晚,我可喜欢快活得叫出声了,没有点{i}帮助{/i}的话,我大概还会再叫。

lines.en: : You want assistance?
lines.zh: : 你想要帮助?

lines.en: : Your hands...fingers...a ball-gag...something for me to bite down on perhaps...
lines.zh: : 你的手……手指……一个口塞球……或者什么能让我咬住的东西……

lines.en: : How about someone else?
lines.zh: : 换个人怎么样?

lines.en: : Do I get to choose?
lines.zh: : 我能自己选吗?

lines.en: : No. And you can’t write about it either.
lines.zh: : 不能。而且你也不能写下来。

lines.en: scene afterthegardener7
: You...were being serious?
lines.zh: : 你……是认真的?

lines.en: : You want something {i}authentic,{/i} don’t you? You want darkness in its purest form. You want to watch people like me crumble from the inside out.
lines.zh: : 你想要某种{i}真实的{/i}东西,不是吗?你想要最纯粹的黑暗。你想看着像我这样的人从内到外一点点崩塌。

lines.en: : Those things are not intrinsically connected. By “authenticity,” I simply meant that I want to see the real you, not the facade you wrap yourself up in.
lines.zh: : 这两者没有必然联系。我说的「真实」,只是想看到真正的你,而不是你把自己裹起来的那层伪装。

lines.en: : Then is it “me” you’re actually interested in? Or just that “facade?”
lines.zh: : 那你真正感兴趣的是「我」,还是只是那层「伪装」?

lines.en: : I suppose it’s...both.
lines.zh: : 我想……两者都有。

lines.en: : The real me doesn’t love you, Nodoka. He barely cares for you at all. And he isn’t sure how he {i}can{/i} when you barely even seem human most days.
lines.zh: : 真正的我并不爱你,Nodoka。他几乎一点都不在乎你。而且你大部分时候连个人样都没有,他都不知道该怎么{i}在乎{/i}。

lines.en: : He just wants to fuck you.
lines.zh: : 他只想操你。

lines.en: : Maybe he’s running from something, maybe he’s not. But right now, he doesn’t care. He just wants your body.
lines.zh: : 也许他在逃避什么,也许没有。但此刻他不在乎。他只想要你的身体。

lines.en: : Is that “authentic” enough for you?
lines.zh: : 这样够「真实」了吗?

lines.en: : Yes. In fact, I’m rather turned on after hearing all that.
lines.zh: : 够。事实上,听完这些我还挺兴奋的。

lines.en: : And I will not refuse anything you’d have me do to help alleviate your pain...but I will ask you this-
lines.zh: : 而且为了帮你减轻痛苦,你要我做什么我都不会拒绝……但我想问你——

lines.en: : Are you truly okay with dragging someone else down to our level? Or would this sanctuary be sweeter with just the two of us?
lines.zh: : 你真的愿意把另一个人拖到我们这个层次吗?还是说,只有我们两个人时,这个避难所会更甜蜜?

lines.en: : I don’t care about a “sanctuary” and I don’t care about whatever it is you’re after. I just need your help forgetting something.
lines.zh: : 我不在乎什么「避难所」,也不管你到底在图什么。我只需要你帮我忘记一件事。

lines.en: : Then why wait for “assistance” at all? Why not take me right now?
lines.zh: : 那为什么要等什么「帮助」?为什么不现在就要了我?

lines.en: scene black
: Because {i}I{/i} am the type to revel in the suffering of others.
lines.zh: : 因为{i}我{/i}是那种以他人的痛苦为乐的人。

lines.en: : And sharing {i}my{/i} suffering with someone who can’t feel does nothing for me.
lines.zh: : 而把一个感受不到痛苦的人拉来分担{i}我的{/i}痛苦,对我毫无意义。

lines.en: {i}One hour...and one bus ride later...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}一个小时……外加一趟巴士之后……{/i}

lines.en: scene afterthegardener8
It didn’t take any convincing at all to get Haruka here.
lines.zh: 把 Haruka 叫到这里来,根本没费一点口舌。

lines.en: I suppose she’s more serious about being my slave than I thought.
lines.zh: 看来她对当我的奴隶,比我以为的还要认真。

lines.en: She even took it upon herself to get dressed up.
lines.zh: 她甚至主动精心打扮了一番。

lines.en: What a ceremonious gesture to make right before throwing yourself into a bottomless pit.
lines.zh: 在把自己扔进无底深渊之前,还真是隆重的姿态。

lines.en: I wonder if anyone saw her.
lines.zh: 不知道有没有人看见她。

lines.en: I wonder if she told either of her “work-daughters” that she was going to be dropping by tonight.
lines.zh: 不知道她有没有告诉她那两个「工作上的女儿」,说她今晚会过来。

lines.en: And I wonder when I can get them into this position as-
lines.zh: 还有,我在想什么时候也能让她们陷入这种境地——

lines.en: scene afterthegardener8
No. {i}They{/i} matter.
lines.zh: : 不行。{i}她们{/i}重要。

lines.en: This one doesn’t.
lines.zh: : 这个不重要。

lines.en: : Well, look who we have here...
lines.zh: : 哟,看看这是谁来了……

lines.en: : H-Hey...
: Did anyone see you?
lines.zh: : 有人看见你吗?

lines.zh: 对于那些已经放弃的人来说,夜晚更有生气。对于我们这些少数人来说更有生气——我们早上把自己从床上拖起来,不期待任何事,然后也确实什么都没有{i}经历{/i}。

lines.en: In the dark lies our salvation.
lines.zh: 我们的救赎,就在黑暗之中。

lines.en: In the dark, {i}anything{/i} can happen, because the sun isn’t there to swallow us whole.
lines.zh: 在黑暗中,{i}什么都有{/i}可能发生,因为太阳不在那里把我们整个吞下。

lines.en: We must fend for ourselves and think up the most creative ways to survive because, when the morning comes, it all starts over.
lines.zh: 我们必须自谋生路,想出最有创意的生存方式,因为当清晨来临,一切又会重新开始。

lines.en: We are bathed in blinding light.
lines.zh: 我们被刺眼的光洗礼。

lines.en: And we are scorched from the outside in.
lines.zh: 然后由外而内地被灼烧。

lines.en: scene afterthegardener22
One last quote, similar to both of the others, yet still somehow different, comes from Elie Wiesel.
lines.zh: 最后一句引言与前面两句相似,却又在某种意义上不同,出自 Elie Wiesel。

lines.en: It is this one I find the most accurate, and it goes like this—
lines.zh: 这一句是我认为最贴切的,它是这么说的——

lines.en: Night is purer than the day.
lines.zh: 夜晚比白昼更纯粹。

lines.en: It is better for thinking, loving, and dreaming.
lines.zh: 它更适合思考、爱与做梦。

lines.en: At night, everything is more intense. More true.
lines.zh: 在夜里,一切都更强烈。更真实。

lines.en: And the echo of words that have been spoken during the day takes on a new and deeper meaning.
lines.zh: 而白天说过的话,其回声会带上新的、更深的含义。

lines.en: Tonight, I am thinking.
lines.zh: 今晚,我在思考。

lines.en: Tonight, I am loving.
lines.zh: 今晚,我在爱。

lines.en: And tonight, I am dreaming.
lines.zh: 而今晚,我在做梦。

lines.en: That is all this is.
lines.zh: 这一切就是如此。

lines.en: scene black
That is all this will ever be.
lines.zh: 这一切永远只会是这样。
